text:
incident-bot: Pager: routing-policy-alert (P1) for customer AcmeApps. Spike in 5xx + degraded throughput since 08:05 UTC. SmartRouter chose variant 'gptx-oxo' repeatedly; customer was expecting 'gptx-stable'. Potential fallback loop observed across eu-west/us-west.

oncall-ian: acked. grabbing pager.

sre-maria: jump in — do we have scope? errors vs latency? any SEV from AcmeApps?

cs-ben: Acme opened a support ticket at 08:07. ~12% requests returning 502 body: "model mismatch" and some timeouts. They see user-facing errors for ~10k users (major feature). No SLA yet but CS flagged urgent.

eng-runtime: quick context — we rolled out a small routing policy change at 07:59 to allow cross-region fallback favoring eu-west for capacity. That change also introduced a new variant-preference weight; shouldn't pick an incompatible variant, but paths show it did.

eng-runtime: past hour's routing decisions (sanitized) — note missing route_tag field in many entries: \n```\n{\n  "request_id": "req_9f3",\n  "chosen_variant": "gptx-oxo",\n  "decision_reason": "fallback_capacity",\n  "region": "eu-west-1"\n  // expected: "route_tag": "mobile_chat"\n}\n```\n
observability-bot: Automated log check: ~37% of decision logs in the last 30m missing route_tag metadata. Also missing variant_source and route_id fields for a subset. This likely explains why rerouting/metrics didn't show impacted route.

oncall-ian: ok. immediate mitigation ideas? can we pin Acme to gptx-stable or force a safe fallback?

eng-runtime: we can push a temporary routing override for the Acme tenant to prefer gptx-stable and disable cross-region fallback for them. Quick API: \n```bash\ncurl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/routing/overrides \\n -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL' \\n -d '{"tenant":"acmeapps","override":{"preferred_variant":"gptx-stable","allow_cross_region":false}}'\n```\nWill apply in ~15s after commit.

ops-handoff: I'll prepare the rollback patch too. If override fails, plan B is to revert the policy change at 07:59. Deploy pipeline note: rollout uses canary, but routing config is centrally applied (no simple per-tenant canary).

product-jess: FYI — Acme called product and is seeing feature errors across EU region only. They are blocked on a major release. This is high-impact.

sre-maria: applying runbook steps: 1) apply tenant override, 2) increase routing decision log verbosity for the next 10m (capture route_tag, variant_source, trace_id), 3) create temporary alert on decision-tag-drop > 10%.

incident-bot: Actioned: tenant override request accepted (req id req-override-661). Expected propagation 00:00:15.

observability-bot: Note — decision-logs ingestion pipeline truncated schema due to recent logging-service change (schema v2 -> v3) and dropped unknown fields including route_tag. We have a schema-migration in flight but it didn't backfill.

eng-runtime: thanks — that explains it. We're patching the logger in the runtime to emit route_tag as top-level field while the pipeline migrates. Will push small hotfix.

eng-runtime: hotfix snippet (k8s rollout): \n```yaml\napiVersion: apps/v1\nkind: Deployment\nmetadata:\n  name: smart-router\nspec:\n  template:\n    spec:\n      containers:\n      - name: smart-router\n        env:\n        - name: EXTRA_DECISION_FIELDS\n          value: "route_tag,variant_source,route_id"\n```\nkubectl apply -f hotfix.yaml && kubectl rollout restart deployment/smart-router\n```\n
oncall-ian: executing tenant override now. monitoring logs and customer errors.

ops-handoff: rolling hotfix canary to 3 pods in eu-west first. watch for request latency bump.

(2m) incident-bot: Tenant override applied; initial telemetry shows failed request rate for Acme dropping from 12% -> 2% in eu-west. Customer error pages decreased.

cs-ben: Acme CS rep confirmed partial recovery. They see some user flows ok now. They're keeping the ticket open until fully recovered.

observability-bot: After hotfix rollout, decision logs now contain route_tag and variant_source again. Found earlier loop root cause: fallback rule used variant preference without checking region compatibility, so cross-region fallback continuously selected a variant incompatible with tenant constraints, then fallback tried other region and came back — creating oscillation.

sre-maria: we should add a decision sanity check: if chosen_variant not in tenant-allowed set -> auto escalate to stable variant and suppress cross-region retry. Also add trace_id correlation between request and decision log for better postmortem.

product-jess: request that we notify Acme CSM and include timeline + mitigations. Also propose credit for partial downtime.

eng-runtime: will raise a postmortem and a config lint to catch variant/region incompat combinations. Also will add a migration plan to ensure logging schema compatibility is tested before deploys.

ops-handoff: handing off to eng-runtime and sre-maria for post-incident follow-ups. I'll leave a short oncall note and hand the pager to next shift in 30m.

oncall-ian: confirmed handoff to @sre-maria and @eng-runtime.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 08:47 UTC. Customer impact reduced, monitoring continues.

sre-maria: next steps TODO (short): \n- postmortem writeup + timeline (owner: eng-runtime)\n- add routing decision-schema test in CI (owner: observability-bot / eng-runtime)\n- add alert for decision-tag-drop > 5% (owner: observability)\n- config-lint rule to forbid incompatible variant-region combos (owner: eng-runtime)\n
cs-ben: noted. I'll draft customer comms and coordinate credits.

product-jess: thanks all. huge help. :heart:

ops-handoff: closing active pager. moving to monitoring-only.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active pager at 08:53 UTC.
